low.title: Failed-initialization control is generic rather than a forced System.<clinit> failure
low.finding: The gate proves that unused System and PrintStream remain uninitialized and separately retains catchable first-use/subsequent-use failure behavior with a generated Broken class, while explicitly keeping System untouched. It therefore does not exercise a resource-induced failure partway through the shipped System initializer. This is a narrow residual coverage gap, not an acceptance blocker: the initialization state machine is unchanged by the exact reverse-verified delta, and the successful System initializer is exercised at q1/q7/q4096 with checkpoint persistence.

informational.title: Acceptance is intentionally limited to System.err field initialization and identity
informational.finding: PrintStream is constructor-only. Output, print, and println are neither implemented nor exercised, and the gate states that limitation explicitly. This matches the bounded task rather than constituting an omitted claimed feature.

acceptanceRationale.topic: Exact field and genuine guest initialization
acceptanceRationale.assessment: The pinned Java 8 System image declares public static final err with descriptor Ljava/io/PrintStream; and its guest <clinit> executes NEW, invokes the guest no-argument PrintStream constructor, and stores the resulting reference. PrintStream itself has ordinary guest constructor Code calling Object.<init>; no native binding or fabricated preinitialized handle was added. The generated probe reads System.err twice, rejects null or identity changes, and hands the typed reference through a generated constructor/field. The EVM gate requires both classes initialized and the err static slot nonzero, then proves q1/q7/q4096 terminal equivalence and reopen persistence. The authoritative original30 fact advancing to the next StringBuilder blocker corroborates the exact measured getstatic use without expanding the accepted claim.

acceptanceRationale.topic: Bootstrap preservation and minimal architecture delta
acceptanceRationale.assessment: The reverse verifier pins four accepted parent inputs by SHA-256, reconstructs the candidate from an equal-length domain change, one System image replacement, one appended PrintStream image and reservation, and the necessary count changes, then requires byte-for-byte source equality. It proves 83 parent image functions become 84, every prior image except System remains byte-identical, System stays at root slot44, EnumSet remains at82, and PrintStream is appended at83. Coordinator and driver are exact parent transformations limited to the fresh domain/address; compiler scripts are pinned unchanged.

Whole-source equality to the pinned parent, apart from the enumerated delta, is stronger than isolated constant checks and preserves the CP, Code, frame, heap, VFS, checkpoint, Head, gas-reserve, native-binding, and exception-kind behavior. The verifier also explicitly checks raw30/262144, checkpoint1MiB, frames128, path/transfer bounds, 14 exception slots and 12 global native bindings. Bootstrap commitments hash the new PrintStream bytes at runtime and the System replacement flows through existing slot44; the verifier rejects new precomputed DLIMITS/DBOOT_PRINTSTREAM constants. Build-time code hashes and size assertions are rebound only in disposable copies. The authoritative runs=200 build is 392775 bytes, 441 bytes below the fixed 393216 LOCAL cap.

acceptanceRationale.topic: Replacement, boundary, regression, and receipt gates
acceptanceRationale.assessment: Both owned names are reserved and generated raw replacements are rejected atomically with unchanged roots. The gate retains exact raw30 execution and driver/coordinator/engine raw31 refusals, exact/+1 aggregate-byte boundaries, EnumSet and ACC_ENUM behavior, Enum errors/failure/uninitialized controls, queue behavior, and field-arena OOM. Successful worlds are canonically re-encoded against pinned engine/coordinator hashes, checkpoint SHA/Keccak roots, epoch and counter chains, event ABI, gas/time limits, and exact decoder read ranges. Machine facts report the complete generated gate passed with 1086 canonical receipts.

The implementation and gate consistently describe PrintStream as constructor-only and explicitly disclaim output/println behavior. Machine facts state that original30 remains RUNNING and then atomically refuses on the next missing class, and explicitly record that Minecraft Done is not claimed. These are appropriately bounded workload-frontier claims.
